Class InputDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a generic input device interface for the ShapeEngine input system. Provides methods for device usage tracking, locking, and calibration.

public abstract class InputDevice : IComparable<InputDevice>

CompareTo(InputDevice?)

Compares this input device with another based on priority and unique ID. Devices with lower priority values come first than those with higher values. If priorities are equal, comparison falls back to the unique device ID.
